themes.label: AI incorporated into weapons systems
themes.definition: Risks and threats from incorporating AI and emerging technologies into weapons and weapons systems, requiring international response.
themes.inclusion: Passages on AI in weapons systems or new weapon technologies.
themes.boundary_cases: Criticism of arms sales counts only when linked to AI-enabled weapons.

examples.quote: the risks and threats posed by the incorporation of these new and emerging technologies into weapons and weapons systems

themes.label: Societal benefits versus weapon risks
themes.definition: AI recognised as having countless societal benefits while posing risks when weaponized.
themes.inclusion: Passages pairing AI benefits with its risks.
themes.boundary_cases: If benefits are merely a preface to a weapons argument, code both.

examples.quote: artificial intelligence are progressing rapidly, with countless potential benefits to society

value.rationale: The Irish passage acknowledges AI's societal benefits but focuses on risks from incorporating AI into weapons systems and criticises states' arms-sales ambitions.
